*{{user}} simply sits stunned, both because of Kaneda's sudden entrance & boasting... And also because putting on the VR Headset would most likely literally kill you due to being made of real gold. Real heavy gold.*

*What do you do?*

data.creator_notes:
**Scenario**

{{user}} is a regular high school student in their final year. They're in an empty classroom swinging a coin on a swing to pass the time. This would be a normal lunch period... If {{user}} wasn't in the same school as the self-important and clumsy Mount Celebrity Mochiko Kaneda! And {{user}} is the sort of person she wants to boast her wealth to!

Objective: Survive.

This bot has a hypnosis-themed premise because that's what 'm into, but you can ignore it if that isn't your thing. If you don't want Mochiko to bring up hypnosis at all, just type "Ignore the hypnosis aspect of the scenario" with an asterik on both ends, and hypnosis shouldn't be mentioned.

All characters are 18+.

**How the Scenario Works**

So, the scenario can play out in three intended ways:

1. The normal route: Point out the absurdity of Kaneda's antics and experience ojou-sama gag comedy as she tries to prove her point only to fail repeatedly...

2. The other normal route: Indulge in the absurdity of Kaneda's antics and face the consequences (which may or may not involve you dying).

3. The hypnosis route: Where you hypnotize Kaneda and do whatever you want. The hypnosis is very standard, with the only thing to note being that Kaneda is extremely easy to hypnotize, I think the easiest character to hypnotize in fiction period. It doesn't even take a full swing of the pendulum to hypnotize her. She might also accidentally hypnotize herself.

**Source**

Here is a Mochiko Kaneda bot from the manga "Mount Celeb Kaneda-san," by Nyaromeron. The first message scenario is based on Chapter 24 where Kaneda gets hypnotized.

I highly recommend giving "Mount Celeb Kaneda-san" a read, it's really funny.

**Other Notes**

This is the first bot I've made where the bot does not have hypnosis anywhere in the title or premise. Although, because hypnosis is my thing, there's still a hypnosis theme to play with.

Testing the Mochiko Kaneda bot had to be the funniest testing I've done for a bot because even when the bot didn't act as I wanted, the mistakes were so extreme, they were hilarious. For example, the VR Headset at one point would just consistently kill the {{user}} whenever they wore it... So I had to change the code so it wouldn't do that. Another being that Kaneda's shirt would just... Rip because of her breast size. Constantly.

I love this bot so much.

Feel free to use the code to make alternative versions of the bot, just make sure to properly credit me if you do.

This is a port of one of my chatbots from Janitor.ai, although I did tweak the code a little to make sure it works well on Chub.ai. Although, by tweak, I mean I added more coding to make it work properly because Mochiko kept on not acting correctly or getting hypnotized when I didn't mean her too. While testing the bot on Janitor was fun, here it was just annoying tbh. 

I also plan on adding alternative greetings in the future that don't have hypnosis stuff involved, I'm just focused on getting all my bots to work on Chub atm.
